Hi Martin,

Now that November 1, 2026 is behind us, EU Product Identifiers (PIDs) are mandatory on every shipment into the EU.

As a reminder, each product you ship to the EU needs three identifiers:

  1.  Merchant PID (M-PID): your platform SKU

  1.  Non-Standardized Manufacturer PID (NS-PID): the manufacturer’s reference

  1.  Standardized Manufacturer PID (S-PID): a barcode such as an EAN, where one exists

If your catalog still has gaps, now is the time to close them so your EU orders keep moving.
